description.text: The third expansion pack of the Pocket Monsters Card Game, released in Japan in June 1997. It brings in the ancient Pokémon revived from fossils, Omanyte, Kabuto and Aerodactyl, which are not Basic Pokémon but evolve from the Trainer card Mysterious Fossil. With the legendary birds Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres and the mythical Mew also here, every one of the 151 Pokémon of Red and Green had now appeared in the game. The English Fossil came out in October 1999.
